assets.name: heads
assets.prompt:
Create a game animation HEAD PART model sheet from the attached canonical character. Exactly THREE isolated cutout heads horizontally across one transparent landscape canvas. No full bodies, no torso, no shoulders, no cape, no collars. Include the entire hair, skull, face, ears and a short natural neck ending just below the jaw. Match the reference character EXACTLY: same brown hairstyle and face identity, same realistic anime painting, same cranial proportions and face width. These three heads are the SAME person at the SAME skull scale and same lighting, intended to be interchangeable animation parts.
Left: the exact three-quarter RIGHT-facing head from reference, looking to screen right, neutral determined expression. This is the main canonical head; faithfully preserve his face and hair, do not make him younger or change proportions.
Middle: same head turned to RIGHT PROFILE, nose pointing right, same skull height and depth, natural amount of visible face, no exaggerated hair mass.
Right: same head seen from BACK THREE-QUARTER, still looking screen right with only a narrow glimpse of cheek/nose at the right edge. Same skull size, same hairstyle.
All three heads upright at the SAME HEIGHT and SAME SCALE, evenly spaced with wide transparent gaps. No text, labels, frames, shadows, weapons, shoulders, bodies or background. Clean transparent alpha, complete silhouette not clipped.
